messages:
lee: FYI ap-southeast1c showing weird packing behavior: small GPU jobs (<=1g) are getting scattered across three racks causing high cross-rack TX and occasional preempts. Not a full outage but tail latency is up. Anyone seen this packing jitter?

anya: saw it too. binpacking heatmap -> hotspots on rack-x/rack-y. Scheduler logs show repeated preferred affinity matches failing then falling back to other racks. Might be due to stale node label propagation after a node reboot.

infra-bot: automated check: node-label-sync-lag detected on 4 nodes in ap-southeast1c (last label update > 90s). Recent rolling-restart of kubelet on those hosts. Correlated increase in inter-rack bandwidth usage.

felix: quick fix idea: run a scheduler filter to prefer already-packed racks for tiny GPU pods for 10m window to let cache/KV affinity settle. Script: `kubectl apply -f scheduler-prefer-packed-canary.yaml -n kube-system`

anya: prefer-packed could reduce cross-rack churn, but be careful — it may create temporary islands. Recommend a canary in ap-southeast1c only and monitor p99 egress.

lee: also let's re-run the label-sync daemon on the 4 nodes. If kubelet restarts lost the `rack` label, that'll explain affinity falling through.

infra-bot: created incident INC-4512. tasks: (1) run label-sync (anya), (2) canary scheduler tweak (felix), (3) monitor net egress and eviction rate (lee).

felix: canary manifest ready. Will flip for 15m and revert automatically. It reduces `rackAffinity.weight` for pod >1 to avoid overconsolidation.

anya: label-sync completed on 4 nodes. Confirmed `rack` labels present. Reconcile delay appears fixed.

lee: after label-sync, scheduling fallback rate dropped and p95 scheduling latency for 1G pods fell from 72s -> 28s. Cross-rack egress down 40%. Evictions stopped.

pagerduty: alert cleared: packing-jitter-ap-southeast1c at 03:14 UTC.

felix: canary will auto-revert in 15m. I'll open a follow-up to add a labeling health probe to avoid this next time.

anya: +1 on the probe. Also propose we add a preflight check in rolling node reboots to validate label reap **before** marking node Ready.

lee: thanks all. filing RCA follow-up: root cause = kubelet restart + label-sync agent lag -> affinity mismatch -> scatter packing -> cross-rack egress pressure -> evictions.
